Conversion help

If a file will not convert, start here: the step-by-step conversion guide covers the normal workflow; troubleshooting covers failed conversions, upload errors, and quota messages; formatting notes explain what carries over cleanly; the scanned-PDF guide covers image-only files; and the password guide explains locked files. Common limits: files must be under 25 MB on free accounts, and free conversions reset daily.

Account and billing

For sign-in trouble, use the password reset page. To subscribe to Pro, use the pricing section. Your plan and subscription are on your Account settings page.

Refund requests

You can get a full refund within 14 days of any payment, with no conditions. Email support@pdf2wordly.com with the email address of your account and, if you have it, the order number from your Paddle receipt. Paddle, our Merchant of Record, sends the money back to your original payment method. Details: Refund Policy.

Privacy requests

Questions about your data — access, correction, deletion, or export — are covered in the Privacy Policy, including what is stored and for how long. Converted files are deleted automatically after processing; they are never made public.

Direct contact

Email us at support@pdf2wordly.com. We reply within 2 business days. Please write from the email address of your PDF2Wordly account when your question is about your account or a payment.
